newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvia's Ventspils June reloadings rise slightly.
newsitem.headline: Latvia's Ventspils June reloadings rise slightly.

text.p: Reloadings of crude and oil products at the Ventspils Nafta terminal, the leading Baltic outlet of Russian crude, rose to 2.1 million tonnes in June from 2.0 million in May.
It reloaded 1.2 million tonnes of crude, unchanged for the last three months, and 845,000 tonnes of diesel, a rise of 161,000 tonnes from May, the port company said in a statement.
It said diesel reloadings were close to this year's high of one million tonnes in March.
The volume of diesel with 0.05 percent sulphur content has doubled to 115,300 tonnes in June against 60,200 tonnes on May.
The statement said the port had reloaded 13.06 million tonnes of crude and products in the first six months, a rise of 81,000 tonnes from the same period of 1996.
The terminal saw throughput of 7.3 million tonnes of crude and 4.8 million tonnes of diesel in the first six months.
